# California Prime Recovery

> > California Prime Recovery is a comprehensive addiction and mental health treatment provider offering medical detox, inpatient rehab, outpatient programs, and sober living services across California with 24/7 support and insurance verification.

California Prime Recovery specializes in evidence-based addiction treatment and dual diagnosis care with multiple program levels including inpatient, PHP, IOP, and online telehealth options. The facility accepts major insurance plans including Medicaid, Medi-Cal, Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross, Blue Shield of California, Cigna, and Kaiser Permanente, and is accredited by the Joint Commission.

## Treatment Programs & Services

- [Treatment Types and Services for Addiction and Mental Health](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/treatment-types-and-services): Overview of inpatient, outpatient, detox, and dual diagnosis services.
- [Medical Detox for Addiction and Substance Use Disorders](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/medical-detox-for-addiction): Medical detoxification with withdrawal management and stabilization.
- [Inpatient Rehab Centers for Addiction](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/inpatient-rehab-centers): 24/7 inpatient rehab with medical support and evidence-based therapy.
- [Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) for Addiction](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/partial-hospitalization-program-php-addiction): Intensive day treatment program with structured care and support.
- [Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for Addiction](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/intensive-outpatient-program-iop-addiction): Flexible outpatient program with therapy and family support options.
